svg.title: Adrenal diseases pathway: too little cortisol is sorted by a morning cortisol and paired ACTH into primary and secondary insufficiency; too much is sorted by product into Cushing syndrome, primary hyperaldosteronism and pheochromocytoma; each column gives how it presents, the tests, the causes and the treatment

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Adrenal disease: one zone making too much, or the whole cortex

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif
Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: always ask about exogenous steroid use

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Too little? AM cortisol 6–9 am + paired ACTH

Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Too much? One screening test per product

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: an incidentaloma is screened for all three
